config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(addHours(e.event_timestamp, 4)) AS ts,
  countIf(e.event = 'BufferStart') AS buffer_starts,
  countIf(e.event = 'BufferEnd') AS buffer_ends
FROM bronze.ott_events e
INNER JOIN bronze.content_dimension c ON e.content_id = c.content_id
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(addHours(e.event_timestamp, 4))
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000
config.name: Buffer Events

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(addHours(e.event_timestamp, 4)) AS ts,
  countIf(e.event = 'upshift') AS upshifts,
  countIf(e.event = 'downshift') AS downshifts,
  countIf(e.event = 'dropped-frames') AS dropped_frames
FROM bronze.ott_events e
INNER JOIN bronze.content_dimension c ON e.content_id = c.content_id
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(addHours(e.event_timestamp, 4))
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000
config.name: Bitrate Shifts

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(addHours(e.event_timestamp, 4)) AS ts,
  countIf(e.event_type = 'VideoSessionStart') AS session_starts,
  countIf(e.event_type = 'VideoSessionEnd') AS session_ends,
  countIf(e.event_type = 'VideoSessionStart') - countIf(e.event_type = 'VideoSessionEnd') AS net_sessions
FROM bronze.ott_events e
INNER JOIN bronze.content_dimension c ON e.content_id = c.content_id
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(addHours(e.event_timestamp, 4))
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000
config.name: Session Lifecycle (Starts vs Ends)
